svg.title: QAgent — WINNER / BEST USE OF BROWSERBASE
svg.desc: Reproduce a web bug, patch it, re-run the browser, keep the receipts. One local-first engine behind an Electron app, a CLI and an MCP server. Dirty checkouts block publish. Built with TYPESCRIPT, ELECTRON, CHROMIUM, SQLITE, AGPL-3.0.
